calls.title: Numida and GrowthBook
calls.summary: The company is aggressively expanding in East Africa, recently securing licenses in Rwanda and Tanzania, aiming for a full regional presence by year-end. Its revenue model relies on repeat loans rather than first-time borrowers, with customers typically breaking even after their fourth loan. Efforts to improve customer experience emphasize building trust through personalized support from Customer Relationship Managers. The data infrastructure is evolving with a migration to Snowflake to support analytics, though experimentation remains limited due to operational constraints. There is an interest in adopting AI-driven tools to enhance GrowthBook usage for faster experimentation. Future collaborations were discussed to improve customer engagement while leveraging case studies and insights.
calls.keywords: Numida, GrowthBook, experimentation, AI automation, East Africa, customer experience
